selection.rule: GICS sectors in largest-remainder proportion to the eligible pool; inside a sector, tickers ordered by sha256(seed|pick|ticker); styles rotate through four in sha256(seed|style|ticker) order starting at seed mod 4
selection.eligibility: latest release-text quarter whose filed 10-Q/10-K facts (revenue, net_income, eps_diluted) the snapshot holds, with >= 30 figures in its indexed sentences (prompt cap 16000 characters)
